predecessors.name: Kingdom of Albania
predecessors.text: Durrës, which Karl Thopia took from the Angevins in March 1368 and which made him recognised as Prince of Albania

successors.name: Ottoman Empire
successors.text: the principality "conquer[ed]" by the Ottomans in 1415 and "incorporate[d] ... into the Sanjak of Albania"

ledger.x: 1359: Tanusio Thopia dies and Karl Thopia succeeds him as Count of Mat; the page's infobox dates the principality from 1359, although Venice recognises him as Prince of Albania only in 1368.
1363: "By 1363 he holds Krujë and nearby territory", after the failed siege of Durrës (April 1362 to May 1363).
ledger.cp: Krujë (previous holder not named by the page)

ledger.x: March 1368: Karl Thopia takes Durrës and is recognised by Venice as Prince of Albania.
c. 1370: Karl takes the Muzaka lands and reaches his maximum extent.
1382: Balša II of Zeta seizes Durrës.
1385: Karl appeals to Murad I, an Ottoman force under Hayreddin Pasha intervenes and Balša II is killed at the Battle of Savra; the page does not name the return of Durrës in so many words.
Summer 1392: Gjergj surrenders Durrës to Venice and dies that September.
1415: the Ottomans conquer the principality and incorporate it into the Sanjak of Albania.

wars.name: Thopia-Balšić war for Durrës
wars.outcome: Balša II seized Durrës in 1382; with Murad I's help Karl Thopia killed him at the Battle of Savra near Lushnjë in 1385.

wars.name: Thopia siege of Durrës
wars.outcome: Karl's first siege failed (April 1362 to May 1363); he took Durrës from the Angevins in March 1368.

certainty.note: A baronial principality with no frontier on the page except the Shkumbin and Seman rivers at its maximum extent.
